newsitem.title: USA: IES Q3 hurt by weather, takeover defense.
newsitem.headline: IES Q3 hurt by weather, takeover defense.

text.p: IES Industries Inc, reporting lower third-quarter earnings, said the weather and takeover defense costs reduced results.
It said weather had an estimated $0.28 per share impact on quarterly earnings.
The utility estimates that costs incurred relating to its successful defense of the hostile takeover attempt mounted by MidAmerican Energy Co reduced its third-quarter results by $0.15 per share.
IES shareholders on September 5 rejected MidAmerican's proposal and agreed to a merger of IES with WPL Holdings Inc and Interstate Power Co.

Increased operating expenses and a higher effective income tax rate also contributed to decreased earnings for the quarter, IES said. It reported quarterly earnings of $20.9 million or $0.70 per share compared to year-ago earnings of $31.1 million or $1.06 per share. Operating revenues fell to $233.9 million from $238.5 million.
